commonPrompt: Original dark-medieval funerary fantasy for a drowned bell-city and ossuary: verdigris bronze, wet black stone, burial cloth, black funeral oil and corpse-blue fog. Painterly realism, tactile materials, strong silhouettes and one readable mechanical idea per image. No card frame, text, logos, trademarks, watermark, gore, existing franchise or named-artist imitation. Non-token art is landscape for a card-art window; both token sources are strict portrait 2:3 full-body compositions.

assets.prompt: A reinforced funerary flying construct with doubled seams, bronze ribs and broad durable wings, clearly built to endure as a 3/4.
A fast undead crypt bat made from bone and torn burial membrane, sharp and airborne but visibly light and fragile, communicating 2/1 Flying.
An undead archive crow flying downward with exactly two blank memory tablets; its shadow suggests the same delivery will repeat on death.
An undead minotaur advances between two grave shields with extremely broad horns, making the need for two defenders readable while retaining a lean 3/2 body.
A 2/2 undead marshal braces ordered ranks beneath the hollow bell while a black-oil ember from one fallen soldier travels toward the unseen Chronicler.
A durable corpse collector fastens armor plates and memory fragments taken from fallen allies onto its own body, showing permanent growth from each death.
A colossal hollow verdigris bell rings over a drowned ossuary and forces every undead rank to straighten into an intimidating formation; persistent Support, not a creature.
A massive 5/3 undead mastiff stands before seven visibly filled ossuary vaults as its gate chain breaks, signaling that a full Memory grants Daunting.
A balanced shroud-bearing corpse crosses an archive doorway while mnemonic smoke pulls away one blank tablet, clearly communicating an on-entry discard effect.
A composite undead mob suspended by exactly five heavy ritual knots; one loosens and releases a separate rank corpse, visualizing five counters consumed to make tokens.
Tiny undead rats hide in a flooded tunnel below the pavement; black funeral oil marks a lethal bite while their scale and concealment communicate 1/1 Furtive.
A broad durable corpse is built around a single sealed memory reliquary that cracks open at death, explaining 2/4 endurance and a death-triggered discard.
A nonviolent symbolic tithe altar beneath the hollow bell holds four extinguishing offerings: a life candle, memory tablet, clay Echo effigy and root-bound Source stone.
A crude asymmetrical funerary flying construct with powerful wings held by sparse uneven stitches, visually communicating strong impact and only 1 endurance.
A lean undead hound consumes the seventh glowing memory tablet and begins to thicken, with six spent tablets behind it and the seventh clearly active.
Strict vertical 2:3 full-art portrait of a monumental communal-grave colossus made from compressed bodies, grave slabs and chains; full figure, low viewpoint, unmistakable 5/5 mass.
Strict vertical 2:3 full-art portrait of one balanced rank corpse standing beneath the hollow bell; full body and restrained equipment communicate a basic 2/2 token.
